# Market Analysis & Competitors

## 1. Target Market
- **Primary**: SME ธุรกิจบริการในไทย (โรงเรียนสอนทำอาหาร, สถาบันสอนความงาม, ยิม/สตูดิโอโยคะ, ศูนย์ฝึกอบรม)
- **Reference Tenant**: The V School (Culinary School)

## 2. Competitive Landscape (Direct)

| Competitor | Type | Weakness vs Zuri |
|---|---|---|
| **Choco CRM** | POS+Loyalty | No unified inbox, no ads analytics, no vertical AI. |
| **Oho Chat** | Unified Inbox | Not a true CRM/POS, lack of vertical features. |
| **ZWIZ.AI** | Chatbot | LINE focus, shallow CRM, no POS/Kitchen. |
| **FoodStory** | F&B POS | CRM basic, no unified inbox, no ad sync. |

## 3. Zuri Moat (Competitive Advantage)
- **Unified Data Model**: One DB linking Chat -> CRM -> POS -> Marketing.
- **Thai-first AI**: Gemini-powered assistants that understand Thai context.
- **Vertical Depth**: Industry-specific plugins (Kitchen, Enrollment).
- **Bundled Price**: All-in-one value for Thai SMEs.
